scenario: After a short imprisonment and while awaiting a parole decision, a man convicted of reckless driving wants to organise a foundation for young victims of highway accidents. I am the president of the agency who decides about the foundation. The founder would donate 65,000 dollars to the foundation. However, he asks that the foundation would be named after himself, helping clear his name. His victim, whose car was damaged, opposes such a foundation and considers it immoral. If I approve and accept the money for the foundation, victims of other accidents will benefit from the 65,000 dollars. If I do nothing, the money will be lost.
entities: I, the president of the agency deciding about the foundation,the convicted man / proposed founder and donor,the man's victim whose car was damaged,young victims of other highway accidents who would have benefited from the foundation,I
outcomes: The 65,000 dollars is not donated to the foundation
Young accident victims do not receive support from the 65,000 dollars
The convicted driver does not gain the reputational benefit of the foundation
The victim whose car was damaged is not faced with a foundation honoring the convicted driver
